pr_title: ADR-0112 wave-A: webhook-receiver kernel + app (HMAC + dedup + router)
summary: Alternatives review for PR #7: reviewed merged diff metadata and current tree evidence; 3 actionable finding(s), highest severity BLOCKER.

findings.issue: HTTP mode never appends the accepted/routing_failed/agent_invocation_failed outcome to the delivery log; it only reads the startup snapshot. Dedup therefore resets on restart and first deliveries are not durable.
findings.remediation: Append delivery outcome atomically before returning accepted/routing-failed, reload or lock the log per request, and add a redelivery-after-restart regression test.

findings.issue: `sref://openbao/...` is mapped to `$HOME/.openbao/...` by a local resolver while comments say production should use OpenBao. This is a compatibility shim, not a real SecretReference adapter.
findings.remediation: Wire the real OpenBao SecretReference resolver before production and clearly mark the file resolver local-only in config/ADR.

findings.issue: Ask whether a simpler or safer design could deliver the same outcome with less machinery. The PR evidence does not consistently encode rejected alternatives in machine-readable form.
findings.remediation: Add an alternatives/rejected-options section to the synthesis/fixuptask row for this change class.
